data.title: Show issue sync status
data.description: The status of issues (synced, committed or local) should be shown against each issue when the 'fleece list' command is run by checking the git status of the .fleece folder against the remote and the last commit. If there are changes between either it should indicate whether each issue has been synced (present and identical in the remote), just committed (present and identical in the last commit but not the remote) or local only (added or changed in the staged or unstaged files).
